name: National Council (Nationalrat)
notes: 200 seats, elected by proportional representation in the cantons. Who sits and their party are from the Federal Assembly's open data. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Council of States (Ständerat)
notes: 46 seats: two per canton, one per half-canton. Who sits and their party are from the Federal Assembly's open data. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
